meta.description: Canonical database reference for Trade Console backend architecture. Reflects finalized decisions: sequential registration lifecycle, activation-link first-login, Valkey-only handoff tokens, double-entry ledger, canonical account_requests FKs, marketing_sites vs marketing_sources separation, 65-table schema.

users.description: Core authentication identity for all platform users (customers and staff).

username.note: Generated by backend on provisioning. NULL before provisioning.

password_hash.note: Argon2id hash. NULL permitted only before account_activated=true. Once activated, valid hash required. Do NOT email plaintext passwords.

account_activated.note: True once customer has set password via activation link.

activation_token_hash.note: SHA-256 of activation token. NULL after activation. Never store raw token.

sessions.description: Active authenticated sessions. Valkey stores session token; PostgreSQL stores metadata.

login_history.description: Immutable record of all login attempts.

source_site.note: Marketing site domain if login originated from marketing site.

security_events.description: Security-relevant events (brute force, suspicious login, etc.).

customer_profiles.description: Customer-specific profile information. Created only after Admin approval and provisioning.

phone.note: SENSITIVE PII — never sent to browser without permission

role_permissions.description: Default permissions granted to a role.

staff_permission_overrides.description: Individual staff permission overrides and assignment-specific overrides.

marketing_sources.description: Traffic source definitions for attribution/analytics. NOT an authentication entry-point allowlist.

marketing_sites.description: Approved authentication entry-point allowlist. Separate from marketing_sources. Backend must enforce approved-domain allowlist for login_url.

login_url.note: Must be on approved-domain allowlist. Never accept arbitrary redirect URLs.

brand_config.note: Brand name, logo URL, colors — used for per-site email template branding.

registrations.description: Raw registration/lead records. A registrations record may exist without a users record. user_id is nullable until provisioning completes.

user_id.note: NULL until account is provisioned after Admin approval.

registration_attribution.description: Marketing attribution data for each registration.

source_site.note: Attribution only — not an auth entry point.

utm_events.description: Granular UTM click/visit events for analytics.

account_requests.description: Customer account provisioning requests. Canonical FKs: registration_id (NOT NULL), provisioned_user_id (nullable), requested_by_user_id (NOT NULL), assigned_manager_id (nullable), marketing_site_id (NOT NULL). No separate account_request_audit table — use audit_logs.

registration_id.note: The lead/registration this request is for. NOT NULL.

marketing_site_id.note: Selected login entry point. NOT NULL.

customer_assignments.description: Current active assignment of a customer to a staff member.

assignment_history.description: Immutable history of all assignment changes.

tasks.description: Tasks assigned to staff members related to customers.

task_activity_log.description: Immutable log of all task status changes and notes.

accounts.description: Financial accounts — customer accounts and system accounts (clearing, fee, settlement). Balance is computed from ledger_entries — no mutable balance column.
uniqueConstraints: (customer_id, currency) WHERE customer_id IS NOT NULL

ledger_transactions.description: Double-entry ledger transaction header. Every finalized transaction must have balanced debits and credits.

reference_id.note: ID of source record (deposit_request.id, order.id, etc.)

ledger_entries.description: Immutable double-entry ledger lines. Source of truth for all balances. NO UPDATE or DELETE permitted.

trading_accounts.description: Customer trading accounts (separate from finance accounts).

verification_cases.description: KYC verification case per customer. KYC is mandatory but presented under Profile/Settings.

verification_documents.description: Documents uploaded for KYC. Binary data stored in Cloudflare R2. PostgreSQL stores keys/metadata only.

storage_key.note: S3/R2 object key. NOT binary data.

document_storage.description: Metadata for all platform-stored files. Phase 2.

conversations.description: Conversation threads (customer support AND internal staff).

message_reads.description: Read receipts per message per user.

calls.description: Call session records. Customer phone number is never stored here.

notifications.description: In-app notifications for staff and customers.

audit_logs.description: Immutable platform audit log. NO UPDATE or DELETE. Used for all account provisioning events — no separate account_request_audit table.

staff_presence_log.description: Historical presence log for reporting. Phase 2.

escalations.description: Escalation records from shift managers / team leaders.

login_handoff_tokens.reason: Stored in Valkey only. Tokens are ephemeral (~60s TTL), cryptographically random, single-use, deleted immediately on redemption. Audit records go to audit_logs.

finalizedDecisions.registrationLifecycle: Sequential. A registrations record may exist without a users record. users/customer_profiles created only after Admin approval and successful provisioning.
finalizedDecisions.firstLoginSecurity: Secure activation/set-password link. Do NOT email plaintext passwords. users.password_hash may be NULL only before account_activated=true.
finalizedDecisions.loginApi: POST /api/v1/auth/login with { identifier, password, sourceSite }. One system supports both direct and marketing-site login.
finalizedDecisions.crossDomainHandoff: Valkey only. No PostgreSQL login_handoff_tokens table. ~60s TTL, single-use, deleted on redemption.
finalizedDecisions.marketingSitesVsSources: marketing_sites = approved auth entry-point allowlist. marketing_sources = attribution data. Separate tables.
finalizedDecisions.documentStorage: External S3-compatible (Cloudflare R2 recommended). PostgreSQL stores keys/metadata only.
finalizedDecisions.financialLedger: Genuine double-entry. ledger_transactions → ledger_entries → accounts. Every finalized transaction must balance. No mutable balance column.
finalizedDecisions.accountRequestAudit: No separate account_request_audit table. Use existing immutable audit_logs.
finalizedDecisions.roles: 23 canonical roles. Three-layer permission resolution: assignment-specific override → staff override → role default → deny.
